text: Given a valid X-Runzero-Api-Token, When runzero_list_assets is called with no filters, Then it returns a bounded asset list with total/has_more, each asset carrying id/names/addresses/os/risk fields

Given a valid token, When runzero_list_assets is called with a search filter, Then only assets matching that filter are returned (verified against a mocked RunZero response containing both matching and non-matching records)
Given a valid token, When runzero_list_sites is called, Then it returns the organization's sites with id and name
Given a valid token and a site_id, When runzero_start_scan is called, Then it starts a scan and returns a scan_id and status, with readOnlyHint=false and idempotentHint=false declared on the tool
Given a valid token, When runzero_start_scan is called without a site_id, Then it is rejected with error code invalid_argument and no scan is started (no implicit "scan everything")
Given a valid token, When runzero_list_scans is called, Then it returns recent scan tasks each with a status field (queued/running/complete/failed) that a caller can poll
Given a valid token, When runzero_list_vulnerabilities is called with no filters, Then it returns vulnerability records each with id/cve/severity/asset_id
Given a valid token, When runzero_list_vulnerabilities is called scoped to one asset_id, Then only that asset's vulnerabilities are returned
Given no X-Runzero-Api-Token Header is sent, When any tool is called, Then the service returns 401 with the required Header name listed in the body, not a 500
Given RunZero returns 429, When a tool calls it, Then the tool surfaces {"error": {"code": "rate_limited", "retryable": true, ...}} instead of an unhandled exception
Given RunZero returns 401 (expired/invalid token), When a tool calls it, Then the tool surfaces {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false, ...}}

Given two sequential requests use two different tokens (simulating two tenants), When each request completes, Then the per-request ContextVar is reset and neither request's token is observable from the other's handler
Given a real RunZero account and token, When runzero_list_assets and runzero_list_vulnerabilities are called, Then the returned data matches what the RunZero console shows for the same organization
steps: Obtain a real RunZero Export or Organization token for a test org
Set it as X-Runzero-Api-Token and call runzero_list_assets with no filters
Open the RunZero console for the same org and compare asset count and a sample of vulnerability records
expect: Asset count and a sample of vulnerability records returned by the tools match the RunZero console for the same org
evidence: needs a real RunZero account; not available at design time. Not a blocker per the completion criteria (no test account is not a blocker).

text: Given a real RunZero account, a disposable test org, and a site_id, When runzero_start_scan is called, Then a scan actually starts and becomes visible in the RunZero console
steps: Obtain a real RunZero Organization token scoped to a disposable test org (never run against a production org)
Call runzero_start_scan with that org's site_id
Open the RunZero console for the test org and confirm a new scan appears with a matching scan_id
expect: A new scan appears in the RunZero console for the test org, with a scan_id matching the tool's response
evidence: needs a real RunZero account and a disposable test org; not available at design time. Not a blocker. Must not be run against a production RunZero org.
